response.query: Studies on military experience on corporate boards, audit quality, and earnings management in emerging markets, focusing on Pakistan Stock Exchange (2010–2022). Topics include upper echelons theory, accrual and real earnings management, board connections, governance, and moderation effects of audit quality.
response.answer: Military experience on corporate boards in Pakistan (2010–2022) correlates with improved audit quality and reduced earnings management, aligning with upper echelons theory. Governance and board connections play significant roles in these outcomes.
